brique._comment: Engine-native Reflexive family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: vocabulary.query
objective.description: Return one complete semantic axis or one complete subtree selected within it.

#root.role: Run a root-only vocabulary query for one selected semantic axis and optionally restrict the response to one relative path, always returning the selected subtree in full.

axis._comment: Required semantic axis. The complete filtered subtree of this axis is returned in one response.

path._comment: Optional dot-separated path relative to params.axis, for example music.classification with axis=functional. When absent or empty, the complete axis is returned. When present, the complete subtree rooted at that path is returned; this is not a one-level child traversal.
The effective relative path, or an empty string when the complete axis was requested.

vocabulary._comment: The complete filtered JSON value stored at the selected axis/path, including all nested paths and retained values. It is normally an object, but may be an array when path targets a vocabulary leaf.

effects.vocabulary_overlay: The root vocabulary JSON projection is read-only.

transformation_contract.morphing: A root vocabulary axis query, optionally narrowed by one relative path, becomes the complete projected value rooted at that selection.
invariants: vocabulary.query is root-only and reads the derived global vocabulary projection.
The projection exposes only paths rooted at brique, objective, functional, or subjective and applies the same filtering policy as vocabulary.get.
Exactly one of the four axes is required.
An absent path returns the complete axis; a present path restricts the result but still returns its complete subtree rather than only its immediate children.
params.path is relative to params.axis and never changes the contextual scope of meaning.query.
The complete selection, including retained values, is returned without mutating projection state.
success: On success, vocabulary.query returns payload.axis, payload.path, and payload.vocabulary containing the complete selected axis or subtree.
An empty vocabulary object is a valid successful result when the selected axis has no materialized semantic content.
failure: The capacity is refused outside the root context.
The capacity fails with invalid when params.axis is absent or is not one of brique|objective|functional|subjective.
The capacity fails with invalid when params.path is malformed, and with not_found when it does not resolve below the selected axis.
The capacity fails when the materialized vocabulary is unavailable or cannot be decoded.
notes: Start with the complete axis when the LLM needs the whole semantic dimension; use path when the relevant branch is already known and a smaller response is sufficient.
Path restriction never returns only one level: the complete matching subtree and all retained leaf values are included.
Use vocabulary.get only when all four axes are intentionally required in one response.
A field omitted from the vocabulary is not omitted from the meaning index; meaning.query can still filter on its exact semantic path.

This queries a projection snapshot, not a live mirror of the filesystem — see meaning.rebuild's role and vocabulary.get's note on staleness. An empty or sparse axis that should have content is more likely stale or unpopulated than genuinely empty; consider meaning.rebuild before concluding the world lacks what you expected.
